TMDB tv/261217 is the Mexican Prime Video dark comedy La liberación (Alejandra Márquez Abella, premiered Jan 2025), with 1 season of 7 episodes. TheTVDB lists E7 'El Hechizo' as the season finale and SensaCine also says 7 episodes, so the EPG's T1 E8/E12 cannot be this work. I found no Spanish linear broadcast of it, and the real EPG programme is still unidentified.
